notes: LA12X is a 4-channel, 2U "amplified controller" (12,000W class-D amp + DSP) for L-Acoustics loudspeakers. Data pulled from the manufacturer's official Product Spec Sheet PDF (LA12X_SPS_EN_2.5, footer print date 2.4/01-2024) and its rear-panel product photo. Rear panel: 8x XLR3 (4 shared AES/EBU-digital-or-analog inputs on channels A/C, plus B/D pure analog inputs, each paired with an active XLR link/thru output with bypass relay), 2x 4-pole speakON outputs (OUT1/2, OUT3/4), 1x proprietary 8-point circular "CA-COM" connector carrying all 4 outputs combined (not a real speakON — closest available id used, flagged in its port note), 2x etherCON Gigabit Ethernet ports (Milan-AVB audio + control, labeled "L-NET Link/Act"), and 1x round twist-lock powerCON mains inlet (100-240V, universal SMPS w/ PFC). No physical connectors on the front panel (display/knob/buttons only). Grade omitted on all XLR/AES3 ports since AES3/analog audio isn't part of the given grade taxonomy; eth-1g set on the two network ports per the spec sheet's explicit "Dual-port Ethernet Gigabit interface." Output power: 3300W/2.7Ω, 2600W/4Ω, 1400W/8Ω (4ch driven).

ports.name: AES/EBU In C&D / Analog In C
ports.note: Shared XLR jack: 2ch AES/EBU digital carrying channels C&D, or analog input C; active link output with bypass relay

ports.name: Link C&D / Link C
ports.note: Active XLR thru/link output (AES/EBU or analog pass-through)

ports.name: Out 1-4 (CA-COM)
ports.note: Proprietary L-Acoustics 8-point circular CA-COM connector combining all 4 output channels (A-H); no exact match in connector list, mapped to speakon as closest loudspeaker-output analog

ports.name: L-NET 1 (Link/Act)
ports.note: Dual-port Gigabit Ethernet (Neutrik etherCON) for Milan-AVB audio networking and third-party control (Q-SYS/Crestron/Control4/Savant/HTTP API)

ports.name: L-NET 2 (Link/Act)
ports.note: Second port of the dual-port Gigabit interface, for daisy-chain/redundancy
